:::{#def-training-set}
#### Training set

A **training set** is the data
to which a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) is applied,
written as an ordered list of $n$ observations:

$$
\trainset \eqdef \paren{(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)}.
$$ {#eq-training-set}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2], who also write the training set as $\mathcal{T}$.
:::

:::
